title: Fourier concentration at a learning degree
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, let $t$ be a positive rational number, and let $\varepsilon$ be rational with $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$. If the total influence of $f$ is at most $t$, then the sum of its squared Fourier coefficients over subsets whose size is greater than $\lceil 8t/\varepsilon\rceil$ is at most $\varepsilon/8$.
hypotheses_covered: The total influence of $f$ is at most $t$
